verdict: Organic profiles are holding volume; recent softening is being watched closely.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, every lead-generation action came entirely from your Google Business Profiles — paid advertising on Meta and Google ran at zero spend for the full 28 days. Combined, the three profiles logged 392 total actions (calls, direction requests, and web clicks), which shows your organic presence is the active revenue surface right now. In the most recent 7 days, Forte Metals and O'Hare Precision both saw GBP activity pull back — down 63% and 32% respectively — while Advance Grinding moved the other direction, up 52% week over week. The near-term focus is stabilising visibility at the two softening locations and ensuring the Advance Grinding momentum holds into next week.

watch_item.issue: GBP activity has dropped sharply at Forte Metals (−63%) and O'Hare Precision (−32%) over the last 7 days, with near-zero actions recorded in the final two days of the window.
watch_item.fix: Profile health and local search visibility are being reviewed at both locations this week to identify and reverse the cause before the dip extends further.
